notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Saheeli, Sublime Artificer
description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Arc Blade.
Arc Blade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Saheeli, Sublime Artificer triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Arc Blade.
Repeat.

uses.name: Arc Blade
uses.cardState: with three or fewer time counters on it
